{{Quote|He's dead, you fool!|A pirate reprimands the Wookiee for killing Marka Durn|<ref name="Mott" />}}
A '''Wookiee''' [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] worked for [[Xishel]], a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] competing for control of the fractured [[Nanth'ri Pirates]],<ref name="Mott" /> a loose assortment of brigands who plundered the [[Nanth'ri Route]] under [[Celis Mott]]. Following Mott's capture by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Era">This adventure occurs while Celis Mott is captured. [[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']] establishes that this occurs after the genesis of the [[Shantipole Project]], circa the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].</ref><ref name="Otherspace">[[Otherspace (adventure)|''Otherspace'']]</ref> Xishel hired the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Marka Durn]] to uncover Mott's treasure hoard. When Durn tried to squeeze Xishel for more [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], Xishel dispatched this Wookiee, along with several other pirates, to [[Death/Legends|kill]] Durn. The Wookiee shot Durn fatally in the chest, but not before the Human passed on clues to the treasure's location to an [[Marka Durn's associate|old associate]]. The pirates confronted the associate and tried to bully him into revealing Durn's message; however, following a [[Lightfight|firefight]], the ruffians were forced to flee.<ref name="Mott" />

The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] was proficient with both a [[blaze-cutlass]] and a heavy [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcaster]];<ref name="Mott" /> the latter a traditional Wookiee weapon.<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> While working as a pirate, the Wookiee wore a [[Bandana/Legends|bandana]] and a [[baldric]].<ref name="Mott" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Timothy S. O'Brien]] created this Wookiee for the adventure ''[[The Treasure of Celis Mott]]'', published in [[1996]] as part of the guidebook ''[[Instant Adventures]]''. The Wookiee was illustrated by [[Paul Daly]].<ref name="Mott" />
